title: A unique coffee experience in Barcelona
text:
We really enjoyed this walking coffee tour with Chris. He is a great storyteller and took us to both the most historic and the best modern coffee spots in Barcelona, beautifully connecting the story of coffee with the history of the famous neighbourhoods, Gothic and El Born.
We learned a lot about Barcelona’s past, local traditions, and coffee itself. And making our own espresso on a historic Italian coffee machine was a unique and memorable highlight.
Totally recommended for all coffee lovers, and also for anyone just stepping into the coffee world. Bravissimi
author: 216evgeniab
